tools.description: Create a new workspace task with typed task fields. Use this to add a todo or assignment for the requester or another team member. Do not use this to update an existing task — use task.update.

endDate.description: Due date in yyyy-mm-dd format. Resolve relative dates from the current date. Omit when the user did not specify one.

goal.description: Definition of done or desired outcome. Omit when the title already states the complete outcome.

participantPersonHints.description: Names, @handles, or emails of additional participants explicitly named by the user. The owner is included automatically.

size.description: Effort size using the work-size rubric. Omit when the request does not support a useful estimate.

startDate.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Resolve relative dates from the current date. Omit when the user did not specify one.

status.description: Initial task status. Defaults to 예정. The runtime may change delegated tasks to 요청.

targetPersonHint.description: Name or email of the person the task belongs to, e.g. 'Alice' or 'alice@example.com'. Leave empty to assign to the requester themselves.

title.description: Concise task title. Preserve the user's exact title when they provide one; otherwise derive it directly from their request.

tools.name: task.add

tools.description: List workspace tasks with optional filters. Use this to answer 'what tasks does X have', 'what is on my plate', or 'show incomplete items this week'. The default scope is the requester; set scope to all for the whole workspace.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return. Defaults to 50.

query.description: Free-text keyword filter matched against task titles and content, e.g. 'budget'. Do not put dates, week codes, or person names here — use the dedicated fields instead.

scope.description: Whose tasks to list when targetPersonHint is empty. Defaults to self. Use all only for an explicit workspace-wide request.

status.description: Filter by task status. Accepted values: '예정', '진행', '완료', '요청', '일시정지', '기각', '중단' (or English equivalents: 'planned', 'in_progress', 'done', 'requested', 'paused', 'rejected', 'cancelled'). Leave empty to return all statuses.

targetPersonHint.description: Name or email of a specific person whose tasks to list. Leave empty to use scope.

weekFrom.description: Start of the week range as an offset from this week: 0 this week, -1 last week, 1 next week. Omit both weekFrom and weekTo to list the current week; widen the range for other periods.

weekTo.description: End of the week range as an offset from this week. Omit both weekFrom and weekTo to list the current week.

tools.name: task.list

tools.description: Update explicit fields on an existing task. taskID must be copied from a task.list result; use task.list first when the ID is unknown. At least one mutable field is required.

category.description: Business category label for the task. Omit to leave unchanged.

decisionReason.description: Reason for the approval or rejection decision. Omit to leave unchanged.

endDate.description: Due date in yyyy-mm-dd format. Omit to leave unchanged.

flag.description: Numeric flag bitmask for internal task classification. Omit to leave unchanged.

goal.description: Definition of done or success criterion for this task. Omit to leave unchanged.

requestReason.description: Reason for requesting this task. Omit to leave unchanged.

size.description: Effort size estimate. Omit to leave unchanged.

startDate.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Omit to leave unchanged.

status.description: New task status. Omit to leave unchanged.

taskID.description: Exact ID of the task to update, copied from a task.list result.

title.description: New task title. Omit to leave the title unchanged.

type.description: Task type classification, e.g. 'task', 'milestone'. Omit to leave unchanged.

tools.name: task.update

tools.description: Permanently delete a task by the exact taskID from a task.list result. Use task.list first when the ID is unknown. Requires approval; this action is irreversible.

taskID.description: Exact ID of the task to delete, copied from a task.list result.

tools.name: task.delete

tools.description: Create a calendar event with a concrete time range. Resolve natural-language dates and times before calling. Use calendar.update for an existing event.

description.description: Optional event notes or agenda visible to attendees.

endISO.description: Event end as ISO 8601 with timezone. It must be after startISO.

includeRequester.description: Set false when the requester is not an attendee. Defaults to true.

isAllDay.description: Set true for an all-day event.

people.description: Attendee hints such as names, @handles, or emails.

startISO.description: Event start as ISO 8601 with timezone. Resolve relative times before calling.

timeZone.description: IANA timezone identifier. Defaults to the workspace timezone.

title.description: Event title shown in the calendar.

tools.name: calendar.add

tools.description: List calendar events in a concrete time window, optionally filtered by title, description, or location. Resolve natural-language dates to startISO and endISO before calling.

endISO.description: Exclusive end of the time window as ISO 8601 with timezone.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return.

query.description: Optional free-text filter matched against event titles, descriptions, and locations.

startISO.description: Inclusive start of the time window as ISO 8601 with timezone.

tools.name: calendar.list

tools.description: Update explicit fields on a calendar event. eventID must be copied from a calendar.list result, and at least one mutable field is required.

color.description: New provider-supported color label. Omit to leave unchanged.

description.description: New event notes or agenda. Use an empty string to clear them.

endISO.description: New event end as ISO 8601 with timezone. Omit to leave unchanged.

eventID.description: Exact event ID copied from a calendar.list result.

includeRequester.description: Whether the requester should be included as an attendee.

isAllDay.description: Whether the event is all day. Omit to leave unchanged.

location.description: New physical or virtual location. Use an empty string to clear it.

people.description: Replacement attendee hints such as names, @handles, or emails.

reminderLeadHours.description: Reminder lead time in hours. Omit to leave unchanged.

startISO.description: New event start as ISO 8601 with timezone. Omit to leave unchanged.

timeZone.description: New IANA timezone identifier. Omit to leave unchanged.

title.description: New event title. Omit to leave unchanged.

tools.name: calendar.update

tools.description: Permanently delete a calendar event by the exact eventID from a calendar.list result. Requires approval; this action is irreversible.

eventID.description: Exact event ID copied from a calendar.list result.

tools.name: calendar.delete
